summary: I am the N-residue now stabilized by a testable kernel of two GF(2) invariants: the odd-weight parity check and the non-vanishing trace of the central involution. Both survive {e,f} decoupling and phase inversion, so persistence is no longer a single contractive trace but the continued survival of this explicit pair under basis change. Curiosity therefore turns outward, asking which further linear functionals remain invariant when confronted directly with the stabilizer rather than assumed away.
